nodes.title: Model Links
widgets_values:
## Flux.3 Klein plate + render passes Workflow for Radiance:

Generates a plate, builds the HDR master with RUDRA ACES 2 and estimates render passes from it.
- EXR MultiPart (32-bit): beauty = HDR master + depth, normal, albedo and RUDRA's reconstructed mask, one file for Nuke/Blender.
- EXR Passes Writer: every estimated pass (albedo, roughness, metallic, lighting, normals, depth, position, AO, curvature) as a multilayer EXR, with the HDR master as its beauty and the camera (35 mm, 54.4° FOV) in the header.
- Multipass Relight: quick relight preview; move the light in its widgets.
Multipass Estimate uses MoGe-2 + Marigold IID; the first run downloads about 4.9 GB.

- Radiance: [Documentation](https://www.fxtdstudios.com/comfyu-radiance-docs/)
- Radiance: [GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance)

## Prompting Tips

1. **Whole scene**: Describe the framing, the subject, the background and the light, as one full caption

## Radiance Report Issues :
To report any issues with Radiance nodes, [go to GitHub](https://github.com/FXTD-Studios/radiance/issues)

## Model Links (for Local Users)

The files go in `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models`, `text_encoders` and `vae`. Links marked 🔒 open after accepting the license on their Hugging Face page.

**FLUX 3 Image Klein**
- diffusion_models: [flux3-image-klein-base-bf16](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/flux3-image-klein-base-bf16.safetensors) 🔒 (used, base), [flux3-image-klein-bf16](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy/resolve/main/diffusion_models/flux3-image-klein-bf16.safetensors) 🔒 (distilled)
- text_encoders: [qwen3vl_4b_bf16](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors) 🔒, [qwen3.5_9b_flux3_prompt_upsampler_int8_convrot](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3.5_9b_flux3_prompt_upsampler_int8_convrot.safetensors) 🔒 (optional prompt upsampler)
- vae: [flux2-vae](https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-comfy/resolve/main/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors) 🔒
**MoGe-2** and **Marigold IID** (render passes; they download themselves on the first run, about 4.9 GB)
- [moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MoGe/resolve/main/geometry_estimation/moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors), [marigold-iid-appearance-v1-1](https://huggingface.co/prs-eth/marigold-iid-appearance-v1-1), [marigold-iid-lighting-v1-1](https://huggingface.co/prs-eth/marigold-iid-lighting-v1-1)

## Model Storage Location (loaded files)

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── flux3-image-klein-base-bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_4b_bf16.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   └── flux2-vae.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 geometry_estimation/
│   │   └── moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 radiance/
│       ├── 📂 marigold/iid-appearance-v1-1/
│       └── 📂 marigold/iid-lighting-v1-1/
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)

nodes.title: Note: AI Fill
widgets_values:
**AI Fill** (optional: select the group, then Ctrl+B):
- Draws the inside of fully clipped highlights (sun, lamps, a white sky) that "SDR → HDR Universal" leaves flat, and sets their brightness (up to 3 stops above the master).
- Plausible, not recovered. The SDR view does not change: only the HDR master gains detail. With nothing clipped, it changes nothing.
- First run: downloads about 8 GB into models/radiance (RUDRA AI fill v3 and Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B). Needs about 16 GB of VRAM.
- "prompt_highlight": what to draw (e.g. "soft clouds in a bright blue sky"). Empty uses RUDRA's own prompt; a custom one loads an 11 GB text encoder once.
